deployment.nodes.none: No node has reported yet. A node reports within its first report interval.
deployment.partial.health: The deployment's health could not be read. This is an outage, not a denial; its identity above is current.

reason.node_not_reported: No node has reported its health yet.

reason.event_plane_failures: The event plane is failing on {node}.

reason.stale: The {check} check is older than its bound.

component.copy.label: Copy {value}
component.confirm.hint: This cannot be undone. The name must match exactly.
component.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
component.pagination.label: Pages
component.pagination.complete: Page {page}: {count} shown. This is the end of the list.
component.pagination.truncated: Page {page}: {count} shown. The list continues on the next page.
component.table.selectAll: Select every row on this page
palette.title: Command palette
fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.lede: The proxies enrolled in this tenant, their health, and the configuration each one reported running.
fleet.summary.truncated: The server counted only part of this fleet; the totals are a lower bound.
fleet.summary.forbidden: Your role in this tenant does not include the deployment health this summary is read from.
fleet.summary.unread: The fleet summary could not be read. This is an outage, not a denial.
fleet.summary.notReported: The server has not computed this fleet's health yet.
fleet.chart.summary: {total, plural, one {# proxy} other {# proxies}} enrolled: {live} healthy, {stale} stale, {unreachable} unreachable, {pending} pending, {revoked} revoked.
fleet.partial.unreachable: {count, plural, one {# proxy on this page cannot be heard from} other {# proxies on this page cannot be heard from}} ({ids}). What is shown for {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} is as last reported.
fleet.partial.summary: The fleet summary could not be read, so the chart is missing. The table is current.
fleet.table.caption: Proxies in this tenant
fleet.table.onePage: This is one page of the fleet. Sorting and filters apply to this page; the rest is on the next.
fleet.selected: {count, plural, one {# proxy selected} other {# proxies selected}}
fleet.empty.title: No proxy is enrolled yet
fleet.empty.body: A proxy appears here once an operator with fleet:write enrolls it through the API, and reports health once it connects.
fleet.filtered.title: Nothing on this page matches
fleet.filtered.body: No proxy on this page matches the filters. Clear a filter, or go to the next page.
fleet.detail.config.never: This proxy has never reported its configuration. It is not known to be running any published document.
fleet.detail.configError: Configuration error, as the proxy reported it
fleet.detail.lastError: Last error, as the proxy reported it
fleet.withdraw.title: Withdraw this proxy
fleet.withdraw.body: Withdrawing {id} removes it from the fleet and revokes every credential it holds. It stops being a routing option at once.
fleet.withdraw.irreversible: A withdrawn proxy cannot come back by itself; it has to be enrolled again.
fleet.withdraw.done: {id} was withdrawn; {tokens, plural, one {# credential} other {# credentials}} revoked.
component.timeRange.order: The start must be before the end.
explain.title: Explain
explain.lede: Paste the session id a user was given, or a decision id, to see why access was allowed or denied.
explain.lookup.label: Session or decision id
explain.lookup.hint: A decision id begins with d_. Anything else is read as the session id a user was told.
explain.start.title: Nothing explained yet
explain.start.body: When a user is denied, they are told only a session id. Paste it above and this page shows the whole story: who they were, which rule answered, the grant, the route and every hop.
explain.notFound.title: No decision under that id
explain.notFound.session: This server took no decision for session {id} in this tenant. Check the tenant, or look the session up in the audit trail.
explain.notFound.decision: This server took no decision {id} in this tenant.
explain.notFound.asSession: Look it up as a session id instead
explain.partial.truncated: This session has more decisions than one answer holds; the newest are shown.
explain.field.subject: Subject
explain.link.trail: The audit trail for this session
explain.story.title: The decision at {proxy}
explain.outcome.default: Denied because no rule matched: the bundle's default deny answered. That is a decision, not a failure.
explain.outcome.standing: Denied by {count, plural, one {a standing denial} other {# standing denials}} applied above policy; the engine was not asked.
explain.outcome.unserved: Policy allowed this, but the server could not serve the answer: {reason}. That is an outage, not a denial.
explain.mapping.none: No claim mapping was involved: the subject's attributes did not come from a federated identity.
explain.mapping.current: Taken under claim mapping version {version}, which is still the active one.
explain.mapping.changed: Taken under claim mapping version {version}. Version {active} is active now, so the same sign-in today may carry different groups.
explain.grant.none: No grant was involved: policy alone decided.
explain.documents.body: The inputs the engine saw, its explanation and the answer served, exactly as this server recorded them.
chrome.supervised.open: Open the audit trail of what this supervisor did here
audit.title: Audit
audit.lede: Every record this deployment holds, append-only and hash-chained. Filter by who, what, where and when; every filter is part of this page's link.
audit.col.subject: Subject
audit.onePage: One page of the matching records: there are more. Sorting acts on this page only.
audit.records.caption: Audit records
audit.records.empty.title: No records yet
audit.records.empty.body: Records arrive as proxies authorize sessions and operators act. When a proxy has delivered its first batch, it is here.
audit.records.filteredEmpty.title: No records match
audit.records.filteredEmpty.body: Nothing this deployment holds matches every filter above. Widen the time range or remove a filter.
audit.counts.caption: {count, plural, one {The # record on this page, by kind} other {The # records on this page, by kind}}
audit.counts.captionCut: {count, plural, one {The # record on this page, by kind — the answer has more pages} other {The # records on this page, by kind — the answer has more pages}}
audit.counts.severities: Records on this page, by severity
audit.principal.title: What one principal did here
audit.principal.supervisor.title: What a supervisor did to this deployment
audit.principal.supervisor.body: Every act through a supervisor's credential is in this deployment's own trail. Where the supervisor named the person it acted for, the name is shown as the supervisor's word: this deployment does not know that person, and nothing here filters or authorises on the name.
audit.record.title: Audit record
audit.blocked.lede: Commands a proxy blocked on targets carrying a label, each with the decision that let the session in.
audit.blocked.label: Target label
audit.blocked.caption: Blocked commands
audit.blocked.decisionGone: This server no longer holds the decision
audit.blocked.partial: {count, plural, one {# blocked command names a decision this server no longer holds, so its access cannot be shown.} other {# blocked commands name a decision this server no longer holds, so their access cannot be shown.}}
audit.blocked.count: {count} on this page, on targets labelled {label}
audit.blocked.start.title: Name a target label
audit.blocked.start.body: Blocked commands are found by a label on the target, such as env=prod: a label lives on the target, not on the record. Name one above as name=value.
audit.blocked.empty.title: No blocked commands
audit.blocked.empty.body: No proxy blocked a command on a target labelled {label} in this range.
replay.title: Session replay
replay.lede: A recorded session, step by step, in the order its records were written. The terminal shows what the session's terminal showed at that step.
replay.noCapture: This session carries no capture: its route did not require one. Its records are listed in order.
replay.partial: {count, plural, one {# capture in this session is not shown: it is marked where it falls, and nothing either side of it is joined.} other {# captures in this session are not shown: each is marked where it falls, and nothing either side of one is joined.}}
replay.empty.title: No records for this session
replay.empty.body: This deployment holds no record for that session in this tenant. Its proxy may not have delivered them yet.
error.decision_unexplainable: This decision's stored record does not carry its own explanation. That is an integrity fault in this deployment's records, not a denial; it was logged under the correlation id below.
explain.documents.noSnapshot: No answer was served: a deny is told only that access was denied, and the session id.
